title: FilesEditor
description: Forget about editing files in a text editor.
body:
Here is the stylish English description for your plugin, perfect for SpigotMC, BuiltByBit (MC-Market), or GitHub.

📂 FilesEditor
Forget about editing files in a text editor!
FilesEditor is a powerful and lightweight tool that transforms tedious .yml file management into a fast, seamless in-game experience. Manage any plugin's settings through a clean and intuitive graphical interface.

✨ Key Features:
⚡ Instant Editing: Modify configuration keys directly in the GUI without ever leaving the server.

🔍 Smart Search: Quickly locate any parameter across hundreds of lines with the built-in search tool.

📖 Fluid Navigation: Automatic pagination (pages) makes browsing through massive files effortless.

🔄 Smart Reload: The plugin automatically executes reload commands (/plugin reload) in lowercase after saving.

🌍 Multi-language Support: Fully localized in English and Russian, with easy-to-add custom language files.

🛡 Safe & Secure: Edit values without the risk of breaking file structures or corrupting database connections.

🛠 How it Works:
1. Type /filesedit <plugin> <file.yml>.

2. Find the parameter you need (use the Search icon for large files).

3. Click the icon, type the new value in chat.

4. Hit "Save and Apply" — your changes are live!
